title: Comparing all AI Pull Request Review tools to find the best one
channel: Morning Maker Show with Sandra and Dan
summary: Hands-on comparison of CodeRabbit, Bugbot, Copilot, Claude Code and Codex reviewing the same PR, with a tier list.

assertions.quote: they are definitely here to stay. They were all useful to some extent

verdicts.note: AI reviewers do catch real defects missed by humans, though with notable false-positive rates; complement, not replacement.

assertions.quote: the code review was pretty much equal to just prompting something directly in Claude code

verdicts.note: Based on one vendor-run demo on one repo; no independent comparison supports or refutes it.

assertions.quote: It did miss those security issues that Code Rabbit has highlighted

verdicts.note: Independent and vendor benchmarks of PR review bots report recall well below 60% and wide precision variation; the specific ranking here is vendor-reported.
